submitted.rationale: EQE rises steadily as the film gets more Fe-rich: 0.102% at Sb 0.160 (index 0), 0.059% at 0.197, 0.021% at 0.258, 0.003% at 0.517 and -0.010% at 0.768. Index 0 is the most Fe-rich composition on the line and has the highest measured EQE. The XRD for indices 0 and 2 is dominated by Pt-substrate reflections (Q ≈ 2.79, 3.22, 4.55, 5.33), so it could not identify the film phase.
